HEADER.TITLE: Arroyo
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Configure the Arroyo features for this account. Every feature starts disabled.

GENERAL.TITLE: General
GENERAL.DESCRIPTION: Business settings shared by every feature.

TIMEZONE.LABEL: Time zone
TIMEZONE.HELP: IANA identifier, for example America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires. Used for send hours and to group the panel by day.

WINDOW_KEEPER.TITLE: 24-hour window
WINDOW_KEEPER.DESCRIPTION: Before a WhatsApp conversation's 24-hour window closes, send a single message with buttons inviting the customer to reply. Only the customer's reply reopens the window.

NUDGE_AFTER_HOURS.LABEL: Send after (hours)
NUDGE_AFTER_HOURS.HELP: Hours since the customer's last message. The message is sent before 23 h 45 min.

NUDGE_TEXT.LABEL: Message
NUDGE_TEXT.HELP: You can use variables such as {variable}.

NUDGE_BUTTONS.LABEL: Buttons
NUDGE_BUTTONS.HELP: Up to 3 buttons of up to 20 characters. Press Enter to add each one.

SKIP_LABELS.LABEL: Skip conversations with these labels
SKIP_LABELS.HELP: Press Enter to add each label.

REENGAGEMENT_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Re-engagement template
REENGAGEMENT_TEMPLATE.HELP: Optional. Approved WhatsApp template sent when the window closes without a reply. Leave empty to disable it (templates are paid).

POST_SALE.TITLE: Post-sale
POST_SALE.DESCRIPTION: Chatwoot records the purchase when the sale label is applied. n8n reads this configuration, schedules and sends follow-ups; Chatwoot checks delivery and creates manual tasks. Alerts use native mentions and each manager's notification preferences.

TRIGGER_LABEL.LABEL: Sale label
TRIGGER_LABEL.HELP: Applying this label records the purchase date and seller. n8n schedules the stages from that date.

SEND_HOUR_LOCAL.LABEL: Send hour
SEND_HOUR_LOCAL.HELP: Hour of the day (0 to 23) used by n8n in the business time zone. Defaults to 10:00 every day.

FREE_TEXT.LABEL: Message when the window is open
FREE_TEXT.HELP: n8n uses this text when the window allows a reply. You can use variables such as {variable}.

TEMPLATE.LABEL: Template when the window is closed
TEMPLATE.HELP: Name of the approved WhatsApp template used by n8n. Check its approval and variables before enabling sends.

DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_HOURS.LABEL: Delivery timeout (hours)
DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_HOURS.HELP: Chatwoot creates a task if delivery is not confirmed after an attempt, or if n8n does not schedule or execute on time. Defaults to 6 hours.

ALERT_USERS.LABEL: Alert managers
ALERT_USERS.HELP: They are mentioned in a private note when manual contact is needed. Configure managers with inbox access before enabling.

AGENTS_SEE_ONLY_OWN.LABEL: Agents only see their own activity

HIDE_NATIVE_REPORTS.LABEL: Hide native reports from the sidebar

EMAIL_MARKETING.TITLE: Email marketing
EMAIL_MARKETING.DESCRIPTION: Email campaigns sent through an email inbox with its own SMTP.

FOOTER_HTML.LABEL: Footer (HTML)
FOOTER_HTML.HELP: Company name and address shown at the bottom of every campaign email. The unsubscribe link is added automatically.

PANEL.TITLE: Agent panel
PANEL.DESCRIPTION: Daily activity per agent. Click any number to see the conversations behind it.

POST_SALE.DESCRIPTION: n8n schedules and sends follow-ups. Check their delivery here and record manual contact when needed.
POST_SALE.DISABLED_HISTORY: The integration is disabled; history remains available and you can resolve pending manual tasks.
POST_SALE.DATE_HELP: Time in {timezone}. A correction only changes stages with no attempt yet; n8n schedules them again.
POST_SALE.NO_MESSAGE: No message has been created for this stage yet.
POST_SALE.RESOLVE_HELP: Record contact you have already made. This does not send messages or change automatic delivery status.
POST_SALE.PRIORITY_HELP: Pending manual tasks appear first. Select a summary to filter; each row is one stage of a purchase.
POST_SALE.REVIEW_HELP: Choose a group to focus on that work, or select a specific status. Choosing another group replaces the previous selection.
POST_SALE.COUNTS_HELP: Counts refer to stages, not customers. Each purchase has multiple stages and a manual task can also be a failed message. Totals follow the purchase filters.
POST_SALE.EMPTY_HELP: Try Clear filters or All statuses. If a purchase is missing, check that it was registered for post-sale and that you can access it.

GUIDE.TITLE: How to read this page
GUIDE.STAGES: Each row is one follow-up stage of a purchase: D+1, D+7 or D+30. Open the details to see all stages and their scheduled dates.
GUIDE.DELIVERY: Sent does not confirm delivery. Delivered and Read indicate confirmation from the channel. Scheduled dates follow the post-sale configuration.
GUIDE.MANUAL: A failed or unconfirmed message may create a task to contact the customer by phone or personal WhatsApp. Recording that contact preserves the original message outcome.

SUMMARY_HELP.ALL: Showing all statuses for the selected purchases. Pending manual tasks appear first.
SUMMARY_HELP.SCHEDULED: Stages with no sending attempt: waiting for a schedule or for their scheduled date.
SUMMARY_HELP.PROCESSING: Messages being prepared or sent, without delivery confirmation yet. Do not assume the customer received them.
SUMMARY_HELP.DELIVERED: The channel confirmed delivery or reading. This does not necessarily mean the customer replied.
SUMMARY_HELP.FAILED: The message failed or the stage missed its scheduled time. Review the reason and any remaining manual task.
SUMMARY_HELP.UNCONFIRMED: The delivery confirmation deadline passed. Review the details and contact the customer if the manual task is still pending.
SUMMARY_HELP.MANUAL_PENDING: These stages require manual contact. Open Record manual follow-up, contact the customer outside the automatic send and save the outcome.

STATE_HELP.AWAITING_PLAN: The purchase is registered; this stage still needs a scheduled date.
STATE_HELP.SCHEDULED: Waiting for the scheduled date. No manual contact is needed for now.
STATE_HELP.QUEUED: The message is being prepared. Delivery is not confirmed yet.
STATE_HELP.SENT: The message was sent, but receipt by the customer is not confirmed yet.
STATE_HELP.DELIVERED: The channel confirmed delivery. This does not imply a customer reply.
STATE_HELP.READ: The channel confirmed the customer read the message.
STATE_HELP.FAILED: The send did not complete. Review the reason and manual task status.
STATE_HELP.UNCONFIRMED: No delivery confirmation arrived within the deadline. Review the manual task.
STATE_HELP.NOT_EXECUTED: This stage was not sent on schedule. Check whether manual contact is required.
STATE_HELP.CANCELLED: This stage is canceled and is not waiting for automatic sending.

NEXT_ACTION.PENDING: Manual contact is needed. Contact the customer and record the outcome using the action in this row.
NEXT_ACTION.RESOLVED: Manual contact has already been recorded. The original automatic message status is preserved.

FILTERS.PURCHASE_HELP: Choose which purchases to review. These filters change the results, not scheduled messages.
FILTERS.DATE_HELP: Uses the purchase date, not the scheduled message date. Follow-ups can continue for a month after a purchase.
FILTERS.SELLER_HELP: Filters by the seller recorded on the purchase, who may differ from the person assigned to a manual task.
FILTERS.INBOX_HELP: Choose the inbox used to help the customer. An empty selection includes all inboxes you can access.

SCOPE.TITLE: Purchases included by your filters
SCOPE.OWN_ACCESS: Your purchases and tasks assigned to you
SCOPE.HELP: All conditions apply together. Clearing filters broadens the search and resets the follow-up status; your permissions still apply.

WINDOWS.CLOSING_SOON_HELP: WhatsApp conversations whose 24-hour window closes in the next 6 hours.
WINDOWS.CLOSED_TODAY_HELP: WhatsApp conversations whose 24-hour window closed today. Only an approved template can reach them now.

WINDOWS.DESCRIPTION: Review WhatsApp messaging windows and open each conversation to continue helping the customer.
